summary: Set 130 Session 3 of 3, 'The contract, the report, and the corrected number' -- the set's terminus. Sessions 1 and 2 built a reader that refuses to guess and the two records that feed it; this session ships the contract that carries the number, the join that produces it, and the two report surfaces that were presenting unmeasured spend as $0.00. SHIPPED (1) disposition.cost across all four surfaces in ONE pass (L-064-8 by name): the Disposition dataclass with omit-null serialization, validate_disposition._validate_cost, ai_router/schemas/disposition.schema.json, and docs/disposition-schema.md. Three rules are enforced on BOTH halves of the parity pair, so a schema-validating consumer and the runtime path cannot disagree: an unmeasured component carries credits: null (0.0 beside status 'unknown' reads as a measurement and no reader can tell it from a real zero, L-112-1); a report containing one has NO total (a total that drops it reports unmeasured spend as zero, the same defect one addition further along); and measured_at 'close' may not claim total_status 'measured', because the turns that author a disposition and run a close are not in the store while the session is closing. The status and component vocabularies are CLOSED and sourced from seat_cost, not re-spelled. SHIPPED (2) the join: seat_cost.session_conversation_ids() / measure_session() read the orchestrator ids from session-state.json's orchestrator.seatSessionIds and the routed ids from router-metrics.jsonl's transport_session_id -- the two records Session 2 shipped -- and price them, with metrics.transport_session_ids() as the selector keyed the way the log actually is. Nothing is guessed and nothing comes from a clock. SHIPPED (3) the report surfaces: print_metrics_report no longer sums billed_usage_unavailable rows into a dollar total (it reports the priced calls under a label naming which measurement they are, states how many calls are NOT priced here and how many carry the id that prices them, and renders '-' rather than $0.0000 for any group with nothing priced in it); close_session prints the recorded cost block with its unknowns named, and when a session recorded none says the spend is UNMEASURED, not zero. It is NOT a gate -- nothing refuses a close for an absent block, because this set measures and does not budget. FIXED, in the same pass and journaled: two PRE-EXISTING parity gaps of the same class, both found by adding a third omit-null field beside them. disposition.schema.json omitted uat (Set 111 S4) and checklist (Set 114 S1) while declaring additionalProperties: false, so the shipped schema deterministically REJECTED exactly the dispositions the uat_walk_recorded and checklist_posted close gates require -- the same defect Set 123 S2 graded Major on verification_qualification. And validate_disposition's dataclass-path dict view omitted verification_qualification and checklist, so a Disposition OBJECT carrying an invented qualification token validated CLEAN while identical content as a dict was refused. A three-way parity test now pins producer keys -> validator allowlist -> schema properties. PROVED, not asserted: 22 new test functions carrying ~40 cases, and 13 defects PLANTED into the production code to show they fire, each reverted from a file copy. Every plant was caught SELECTIVELY (3/91, 1/93, 2/92, 13/81, 1/22, 3/20, 2/50, 2/27, 1/28, 1/33 ...). The first plant initially ESCAPED, which is the useful part of the record: the assertion read 'must be null when status is', which the usd rule also produces, so deleting half the rule left the test green. It now names credits and usd separately. RE-PRICED: Set 118 Session 1, with the shipped tool -- 4,743.2 credits ($47.43) of orchestrator seat plus 866.4 credits ($8.66) of routed verification = 5,609.6 credits / $56.10, against the $42.67 recorded at the time. +31%. Re-derived unchanged today, which is itself the claim of seat-cost.md 5.2: a finished session measures the same every time. Published in change-log.md and seat-cost.md 7 with the command and the predicate, rather than left as a footnote in a cancelled set's disposition. LIVE DOGFOOD: this session's own cost block, in the cost field below, was produced by the shipped assembler from ids the framework recorded itself -- and its routed_seat component is MEASURED, not unknown, because every routed call this session made carried a transport_session_id. That is the whole chain, working, on the session that finished it.
